text.en:
Today you learn to say how you are.
Or where you are, or how things are.
I am ready.
It means: I can start now.
She is busy.
It means: she has things to do.

title.en: Three small words: am, is, are

text.en:
One small word changes with who we talk about.
I am ready.
She is ready. He is ready.
We are ready. They are ready.
You are ready.
Only I goes with am.
One person or thing goes with is.
You, we and they go with are.

You will build short sentences, word by word.
First pick who: I, she, we, they.
Then pick the small word: am, is or are.
Then pick the last word, like here, busy or free.
Check who the sentence is about.
That tells you which small word fits.
